নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ১) 'Locksley Hall' is a poem written by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• 'Locksley Hall' is a poem written by - Alfred Tennyson.
- কবিতাটি হচ্ছে একটি dramatic monologue.
- The speaker of this dramatic monologue declaims against marriages made for material gain and worldly prestige.
- In the poem, the speaker revisits Locksley Hall, his childhood home, where he and his cousin Amy had fallen in love.

• Lord Alfred Tennyson was a represented/ Lyric poet of the Victorian Age.
- His famous Elegy is In Memoriam.
- Famous poems are
- Oenone
- Ulysses
- Lotos Eaters
- Locksley Hall
- Tears Idle Tears
- Tithonus
- The Two Voices
- The Lady of Shalott
- Vision of Sin
- Morte D'Arthur etc.

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ২) Which of the following novels is not written by Thomas Hardy?
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).option1: ক) The Return of the Native
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• উল্লেখিত অপশন গুলোর মধ্যে - Daisy Miller is a novel is not written by Thomas Hardy.
- It is a novel by Henry James that first appeared in The Cornhill Magazine in June–July 1878, and in book form the following year.
- It portrays the courtship of the beautiful American girl Daisy Miller by Winterbourne, a sophisticated compatriot of hers.

• Henry James: 
- He was an American novelist and critic. He was born in 1843 in New York City.
- তিনি তাঁর জীবদ্দশায় ২০ টি উপন্যাস, ১১২টি Tales এবং ১২টি play লিখেছিলেন।

অন্যদিকে, 
- অপশনে উল্লেখিত The Return of the Native, Tess of the D'Urbervilles এবং Under the Greenwood Tree হচ্ছে Thomas Hardy এর বিখ্যাত উপন্যাস সমূহ।
- - Thomas Hardy is known as a Pessimistic Novelist.
- তিনি Victorian age এর শ্রেষ্ঠ উপন্যাসিক এবং ছোট গল্পকার।

Source: Britannica

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ৩) ‘The Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam’ was translated into English from Persian by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• Victorian period এর সাহিত্যিক Edward Fitzgerald, ১৮৫৯ সালে ‘The Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam’ কাব্য গ্রন্থটি কে Persian থেকে English এ অনুবাদ করেন।
-  এই অনুবাদ টি ইংরেজি সাহিত্যের ইতিহাসে একটি Classic হিসেবে বিবেচিত।
- It is one of the most frequently quoted lyric poems and many of its phrases are passed into common currency.

Source: Britannica and An ABC of English Literature by Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ৪) 'The Pickwick Papers' is a novel written by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:

- এটি তাঁর রচিত প্রথম novel. 
- এই উপন্যাস টি তিনি  ছদ্মনামে (Boz) প্রকাশ করেছিলেন।
- This first fictional work by Dickens was originally commissioned as a series of glorified captions for the work of caricaturist Robert Seymour.


• Charles Dickens is considered the greatest novelist of the Victorian era.
• Best Works:
- A Christmas Carol,
- David Copperfield,
- Bleak House.
- A Tale of Two Cities,
- Great Expectations, and
- Our Mutual Friend.
- Hard Times
- The Pickwick Papers

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ৫) The dramatic poem, "The Spanish Gypsy" is written by -

- এটাকে Tragi-comedy ও বলা হয়।

 • Victorian period  এর অন্যতম মহিলা কবি George Eliot, যার original নাম ছিলো Mary Ann Evans.

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ৬) 'The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde' is a novella written by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
•'The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde' is a novella written by - R. L Stevenson.
- ১৮৮৬ সালে প্রকাশিত এটি হচ্ছে একটি Gothic novella (ভৌতিক উপাদান পাওয়া যায় এই উপন্যাসগুলোতে)
- The names of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, the two alter egos of the main character.
- একজন মানুষ পরস্পর বিপরীতধর্মী দুটি চরিত্র তার মাঝে লালন করে।
- এবং দুটি চরিত্র নিজেদের মধ্যেই রুপ পাল্টাতে পারে।
- কখনো সে ভদ্র সমাজের Dr. Jekyll আবার কখনো অসৎ চরিত্রের Mr. Hyde.

• Robert Louis Stevenson:
Robert Louis Stevenson: (1850-1894) Robert Louis Stevenson was a Scottish essayist, poet, and author of fiction and travel books, best known for his works Treasure Island and Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde.
• Best Works:

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ৭) 'Wuthering Heights' by Emily Bronte is an best example of -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• 'Wuthering Heights' by Emily Bronte is an best example of - Gothic Novel.

• Gothic Novel:
-  ভৌতিক উপাদান এবং ডার্ক থিম সমৃদ্ধ হয় এই উপন্যাসগুলো।
- পাশাপাশি দ্বন্দ্ব, সংঘাত কিংবা উন্মত্ততাও থাকে কাহিনী জুড়ে।
- Wuthering Heights by Emily Bronte হচ্ছে Gothic Novel এর একতি অন্যতম উদাহরন। 
- এই উপন্যাসটি ১৮৪৭ সালে তার ছদ্মনাম  Ellis Bell এর অন্তর্গত হয়ে প্রকাশিত হয়।
- This intense, solidly imagined novel is distinguished from other novels of the period by its dramatic and poetic presentation, its abstention from authorial intrusion, and its unusual structure.

• Important characters of this novel - 
- Catherine Earnshaw
- Cathy Linton,
- Edgar Linton,
- Heathcliff (The central character)
- Lockwood etc

অন্যদিকে, 
• Picaresque Novel - A novel that tells the story of a rascal or deceiver who chases adventure and duels with the evil villain. It is realistic in manner and satiric in aim. 
• Epistolary novel: অনেকটা চিঠির মতো করে লেখা এই উপন্যাসগুলো।
• Regional novel:  A novel that depicts in its plot the customs, dialects and ways of life of a specific rural region

Source: An ABC of English Literature by Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica.

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ৮) The Poem 'Rabbi Ben Ezra' is written by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• The Poem 'Rabbi Ben Ezra' is written by - Robert Browning.
- এটি হচ্ছে একটি dramatic monologue.
- ১৮৬৪ সালে কবিতাটি তাঁর Dramatis Personae সংকলনের অন্তর্ভুক্ত হয়ে প্রকাশিত হয়েছিল।
- Through the personage of Rabbi Ben Ezra, a scholarly and learned Jew, the poem sets forth Browning’s religious philosophy.
- The poem’s final metaphor describes life as a pot that is fashioned by the Master’s hand and argues that the value of a person should be measured not by the work done but by the character that has been molded.


• Robert Browning:
- Victorian age এর অন্যতম শ্রেষ্ঠ কবি হিসেবে তাকে গণ্য করা হয়। 
- তিনি খ্যাতি অর্জন করেছিলেন তার dramatic monologues এর জন্য।

Best Works:

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ৯) “The Talisman” is a novel written by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• “The Talisman” is a novel written by - Sir Walter Scott.
- এটি সর্বপ্রথম হিব্রু ভাষায় রচিত হয়েছিল। 
- পরবর্তীতে এটি ল্যাটিন ভাষায় অনুবাদ করা হয় এবং বই আকারে প্রকাশিত হয়।

• Sir Walter Scott, in full Sir Walter Scott, was an Scottish novelist, poet, historian, and biographer who is often considered both the inventor and the greatest practitioner of the historical novel.

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ১০) ‘Thyrsis’ is an elegy written by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• ‘Thyrsis’ is an elegy written by - Mathew Arnold.
- এটি একধরনের pastoral elegy।
- কবি তাঁর বন্ধু Arthur Hugh Clough এর মৃত্যুশোকে এই কবিতাটি রচনা করেছিলেন।
- Arnold portrays Clough as Thyrsis, a traditional Greek name for a shepherd-poet. 
- It is considered one of Arnold’s finest poems.

• Mathew Arnold was a poet and a critic. Mostly known for his strong moral voice.
- He was a professor of poetry at Oxford University..

• Best Works:

- Dover Beach

- Essays in Criticism

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ১১) 'Truth never hurts the teller' is quoted by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• 'Truth never hurts the teller' is quoted by - Robert Browning.
- উক্তিটি তাঁর 'Fifine at the Fair' কবিতা হতে উদ্ধৃত।
- 'Fifine at the Fair' is a poem in Alexandrine couplets by R. Browning, published 1872.
- The speaker is Don Juan, who is strolling with his wife Elvire near Pornic in Britanny, where a fair is being held.
- Don Juan, attracted by the gipsy dancer Fifine, dissertates to Elvire on the nature of his feelings, contrasting the intense ephemerality of desire with the dull permanence of love, this initial theme then giving rise to a series of brilliant variations on the interconnected topics of knowledge, identity, and truth in life and art.

 • Robert Browning is a famous Victorian poet.

• His famous quotations
- 'Oppression makes the wise man mad',
- 'Ignorance is not innocence but sin',
- 'This I enter and thus I go!',
- 'So absolutely good is truth, Truth never hurts the taller'.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britannica and The  Oxford Reference to English Literature

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ১২) 'Alec and Angel' is the important character of ______ by Thomas Hardy.
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).option1: ক) The Return of the Native
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).option4: ঘ) A Pair of Blue Eyes
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• 'Alec and Angel' is the important character of 'Tess of the d'Urbervilles' by Thomas Hardy.
- এই উপন্যাস টি প্রথম ১৮৯১ সালের জুলাই থেকে ডিসেম্বর মাস পর্যন্ত ধারাবাহিক ভাবে প্রকাশিত হয়। 
- একই বছর উপন্যাসটি তিনটি ভলিউমে বই আকারে প্রকাশিত হয়। 
- It was subtitled A Pure Woman Faithfully Presented because Hardy felt that its heroine was a virtuous victim of a rigid Victorian moral code.
- Now considered Hardy’s masterwork, it departed from conventional Victorian fiction in its focus on the rural lower class and in its open treatment of sexuality and religion.

• 'Alec and Angel' হচ্ছে এই উপন্যাসের কেন্দ্রীয় চরিত্র 'Tess' এর দুজন beloved.

• এই উপন্যাসের  চরিত্র সমূহ হচ্ছে - 
- Tess
- Alec
-Angel 
- Sorrow

Source: Britannica and Sparksnotes.

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ১৩) 'Men make their own history' was stated by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ১৪) ‘Adventures of Huckleberry Finn’ is a novel by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• 'The Adventures of Tom Sawyer' is a novel written by - Mark Twain.
- ১৮৭৬ ​​সালে প্রকাশিত এই উপন্যাসটিতে মিসিসিপি নদীর তীরে একটি শহরে বসবাসকারী এক দুষ্ট যুবক Tom Sawyer এর জীবনের নানান কাহিনী বর্ণিত হয়েছে।
- আমেরিকান লিটারেচারে এই উপন্যাস টি একটি ক্ল্যাসিক হিসেবে বিবেচিত। 
- Because of its immense popularity, it spawned the hugely successful sequel The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn।

• Mark Twain একজন American humorist, journalist, lecturer, and novelist who acquired international fame for his travel narratives
- তার আসল নাম Samuel Langhorne Clemens.

- তাঁর উল্লেখযোগ্য রচনার মধ্যে রয়েছে -
- The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
- The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
- The Innocents Abroad
- Roughing It
-  Life on the Mississippi ইত্যাদি। 

Source: Britannica.

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ১৫) Who wrote the book 'Sentimental Education'?

- Sentimental Education (French: L'Éducation sentimentale, 1869) is a novel by Gustave Flaubert. Considered one of the most influential novels of the 19th century. 
- The novel describes the life of a young man (Frédéric Moreau) living through the revolution of -1848 and the founding of the Second French Empire, and his love for an older woman.

Gustave Flaubert: (1821-1880):
One of the great French novelists, regarded as the prime mover of the realist school of French literature and best known for his masterpiece novels. 

• Best Works: 
- A Sentimental Education
- Bouvard and Pécuchet” 
- Madame Bovary 
- Mémoires d’un fou 
- Salammbô
- The Temptation of Saint Anthony 
- Three Tales

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ১৬) The book, "History of England" is written by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• The book 'History of England' is written by Thomas Babington Macaulay.
- The History of England from the Accession of James the Second (1848) is the full title of the 05 Volume work by Lord Macaulay (1800–1859) more generally known as The History of England. 
- It covers the 17-year period from 1685 to 1702, encompassing the reign of James II, the Glorious Revolution, the coregency of William III and Mary II, and up to William III's death.

- He was a spokesman for the late 19th-century Aesthetic movement in England, which advocated art for art’s sake, and he was the object of celebrated civil and criminal suits involving homosexuality and ending in his imprisonment.

• His famous books:
- The Importance of Being Earnest (comedy play)
- A woman of No Importance,

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ১৮) 'Charles Dickens: A Critical Study' and 'The Odd Women' are written by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• 'Charles Dickens: A Critical Study' and 'The Odd Women' are written by - George Robert Gissing.
-  'Charles Dickens: A Critical Study', George Robert Gissing wrote this with a perspective piece on Charles dickens.

• অন্যদিকে, ১৮৯৩ সালে 'The Odd Women' উপন্যাস টি প্রকাশিত হয়।
- Its themes are the role of women in society, marriage, morals, and the early feminist movement.
- the book is considered as a powerful study of female frustration.

• George Robert Gissing:
- English novelist noted for the unflinching realism of his novels about the lower middle class.
- He belongs to the Victorian Period.

• Notable Works of Geroge Robert Gissing:
- Born in Exile
- The Nether World
- Denzil Quarrier
- The Odd Women
- The Paying Guest
- The Whirlpool
- Charles Dickens: A Critical Study

Source: Britannic and An ABC of English Literature by Professor M Mofizar Rahman.

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ২১) Which of the following figures led the oxford movement in the 19th Century?
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• Cardinal Newman led the oxford movement in the 19th Century.

• Oxford Movement in the 19th Century:
Oxford movement, 19th-century movement centered at the University of Oxford that sought a renewal of “catholic,” or Roman Catholic, thought and practice within the Church of England in opposition to the Protestant tendencies of the church.

Leading Figures of this movement :
- John Keble
- Henry Parry Liddon
- Henry Edward Manning
- St. John Henry Newman (Cardinal Newman)
- E.B. Pusey

Cardinal Newman:
- He was born in 1801 and died in 1890.
- He led the Oxford movement in the Church of England and later became a cardinal deacon in the Roman Catholic Church.

Notable works
- The Idea of University(Poem)
- Loss and Gain(Novel).

Source: Britannica & British Library

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ২২) Who wrote the book 'Utilitarianism'?
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• John Stuart Mill wrote the book 'Utilitarianism'.
- It is an ethical principle according to which an action is right if it tends to maximize happiness, not only that of the agent but also of everyone affected.

• John Stuart Mill was a renowned English Philosopher and political economist. He was the leading expositor of utilitarianism.

• Notable Works:
- Essay on Economics and society (Article, 1967)
- Utilitarianism (1863)
- The Subjection of Women. (1869)
- On Liberty (1859) 

Source: Britannica.

নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).question: ২৩) 'Sketches by Boz' is written by -
নতুনদের ডেইলি কুইজ (৪৬তম বিসিএস).exp:
• Sketches by “Boz”, title of two series of collected sketches and short tales by Charles Dickens, writing under the pseudonym Boz.
- First published in book form in 1836, Sketches contains some 60 pieces that had originally been published in the Monthly Magazine and the Morning Chronicle and other magazines and newspapers periodicals. 
- Sketches contains Dickens’s impressions and graphically described observations of the teeming street life of Victorian London.

• Charles Dickens is considered the greatest novelist of the Victorian era.
• Best Works:
- A Christmas Carol,
- David Copperfield,
- Bleak House.
- A Tale of Two Cities,
- Great Expectations, and
- Our Mutual Friend.
- Hard Times
- The Pickwick Papers

Source: Britannica.

২৪) "I will never rest from travels

• Alfred Tennyson কে  Victorian Period এর Chief representative হিসাবে ধরা হয়।
- তিনি তাঁর melodious language এর জন্য অনেক প্রসিদ্ধ এবং তাঁকে Lyric Poet বলা হয়ে থাকে।
